notes: Reset to defaults moved out of Position and into the panel settings, where its reach actually is — it restores the substrate, the card style, every per-panel setting and now the panel's place on screen, none of which is about where the…

⚠️ RESET WAS PATCHING, NOT RESETTING. It wrote three named values back and left everything else the user had changed — every Rune, the sensor shape and grouping, the clock face, the column widths, the alignment. Worse, one of the three…
Reset also puts the panel back in the top-right corner of the main display. A reset that restores every value and leaves the panel wherever it was last dragged has not restored the panel.
"Nothing selected" is now "Configure Runes" — it was naming the state of the selection instead of what the screen is for.
